## createLogger() function

Create a new Pino logger instance.

In development (NODE_ENV !== 'production'), uses pino-pretty for human-readable output when it is installed. Otherwise, including in production, outputs structured JSON.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function createLogger(
  options?: pino.LoggerOptions,
  destination?: LogDestination
): pino.Logger
```
